import os
from posixpath import realpath, abspath, dirname, basename, ALLOW_MISSING
from test.support import os_helper
from test.support.os_helper import FakePath, TESTFN
ABSTFN = abspath(TESTFN)

def _t():
    try:
        os.symlink(ABSTFN, ABSTFN)
        assert realpath(ABSTFN) == ABSTFN, ('assertEqual', realpath(ABSTFN), ABSTFN)
        os.symlink(ABSTFN + '1', ABSTFN + '2')
        os.symlink(ABSTFN + '2', ABSTFN + '1')
        assert realpath(ABSTFN + '1') == ABSTFN + '1', ('assertEqual', realpath(ABSTFN + '1'), ABSTFN + '1')
        assert realpath(ABSTFN + '2') == ABSTFN + '2', ('assertEqual', realpath(ABSTFN + '2'), ABSTFN + '2')
        assert realpath(ABSTFN + '1/x') == ABSTFN + '1/x', ('assertEqual', realpath(ABSTFN + '1/x'), ABSTFN + '1/x')
        assert realpath(ABSTFN + '1/..') == dirname(ABSTFN), ('assertEqual', realpath(ABSTFN + '1/..'), dirname(ABSTFN))
        assert realpath(ABSTFN + '1/../x') == dirname(ABSTFN) + '/x', ('assertEqual', realpath(ABSTFN + '1/../x'), dirname(ABSTFN) + '/x')
        os.symlink(ABSTFN + 'x', ABSTFN + 'y')
        assert realpath(ABSTFN + '1/../' + basename(ABSTFN) + 'y') == ABSTFN + 'x', ('assertEqual', realpath(ABSTFN + '1/../' + basename(ABSTFN) + 'y'), ABSTFN + 'x')
        assert realpath(ABSTFN + '1/../' + basename(ABSTFN) + '1') == ABSTFN + '1', ('assertEqual', realpath(ABSTFN + '1/../' + basename(ABSTFN) + '1'), ABSTFN + '1')
        os.symlink(basename(ABSTFN) + 'a/b', ABSTFN + 'a')
        assert realpath(ABSTFN + 'a') == ABSTFN + 'a/b', ('assertEqual', realpath(ABSTFN + 'a'), ABSTFN + 'a/b')
        os.symlink('../' + basename(dirname(ABSTFN)) + '/' + basename(ABSTFN) + 'c', ABSTFN + 'c')
        assert realpath(ABSTFN + 'c') == ABSTFN + 'c', ('assertEqual', realpath(ABSTFN + 'c'), ABSTFN + 'c')
        with os_helper.change_cwd(dirname(ABSTFN)):
            assert realpath(basename(ABSTFN)) == ABSTFN, ('assertEqual', realpath(basename(ABSTFN)), ABSTFN)
    finally:
        os_helper.unlink(ABSTFN)
        os_helper.unlink(ABSTFN + '1')
        os_helper.unlink(ABSTFN + '2')
        os_helper.unlink(ABSTFN + 'y')
        os_helper.unlink(ABSTFN + 'c')
        os_helper.unlink(ABSTFN + 'a')
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:

import os

    real_getcwd, os.getcwd = (os.getcwd, lambda: '/home/user/bar')

        curdir = os.path.split(os.getcwd())[-1]

            posixpath.relpath(*(None,))

            pass

            posixpath.relpath(*('',))

            pass
        assert posixpath.relpath('a') == 'a', ('assertEqual', posixpath.relpath('a'), 'a')

        assert posixpath.relpath('a/b') == 'a/b', ('assertEqual', posixpath.relpath('a/b'), 'a/b')
        assert posixpath.relpath('../a/b') == '../a/b', ('assertEqual', posixpath.relpath('../a/b'), '../a/b')
        assert posixpath.relpath('a', '../b') == '../' + curdir + '/a', ('assertEqual', posixpath.relpath('a', '../b'), '../' + curdir + '/a')
        assert posixpath.relpath('a/b', '../c') == '../' + curdir + '/a/b', ('assertEqual', posixpath.relpath('a/b', '../c'), '../' + curdir + '/a/b')
        assert posixpath.relpath('a', 'b/c') == '../../a', ('assertEqual', posixpath.relpath('a', 'b/c'), '../../a')
        assert posixpath.relpath('a', 'a') == '.', ('assertEqual', posixpath.relpath('a', 'a'), '.')
        assert posixpath.relpath('/foo/bar/bat', '/x/y/z') == '../../../foo/bar/bat', ('assertEqual', posixpath.relpath('/foo/bar/bat', '/x/y/z'), '../../../foo/bar/bat')
        assert posixpath.relpath('/foo/bar/bat', '/foo/bar') == 'bat', ('assertEqual', posixpath.relpath('/foo/bar/bat', '/foo/bar'), 'bat')
        assert posixpath.relpath('/foo/bar/bat', '/') == 'foo/bar/bat', ('assertEqual', posixpath.relpath('/foo/bar/bat', '/'), 'foo/bar/bat')
        assert posixpath.relpath('/', '/foo/bar/bat') == '../../..', ('assertEqual', posixpath.relpath('/', '/foo/bar/bat'), '../../..')

        assert posixpath.relpath('/', '/') == '.', ('assertEqual', posixpath.relpath('/', '/'), '.')
